column1: # GitHub MCP tools that write what an agent wrote (#1211). raw_command_guard.py refuses each one,
# on any MCP server whose name holds `github` (any case), and names the script instead;
# settings_hooks.py builds the PreToolUse matcher from this list, and validate_repository.py fails
# when the matcher, the committed `.claude/settings.json` or the guard leaves one out.
# script  the owning script or rule, relative to the skills folder, or `-` for git or no owning script.
# scripts/bench/surfaces/github-mcp-tools.json pins the server's whole tool list; every write in it is a row
# here, and validate_repository.py fails on a name neither here nor on its read lists (#1663).
# usage   the usage line the refusal prints.
